# Tropical South Tree Services

> Licensed, insured tree care business serving Cutler Bay, Miami, Homestead, Palmetto Bay, Pinecrest, Coral Gables, South Miami, Kendall, Redland, Goulds, and Miami-Dade County, FL since 2019.

## Core Services & Directional Pricing
1. **Tree Removal** — Safe removal of hazardous, dead, diseased, or overgrown trees.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-removal
   - *Estimated Pricing*: $250 – $3,500+ depending on tree size, location, hazard, and access.

2. **Tree Trimming & Pruning** — Canopy thinning, palm trimming, crown reduction, structural pruning, and hurricane storm prep.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-pruning-trimming
   - *Estimated Pricing*: $150 – $950 per tree depending on canopy size and complexity.

3. **Stump Grinding & Removal** — Complete below-grade stump grinding and root removal.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/stump-grinding
   - *Estimated Pricing*: $100 – $450 per stump based on diameter and root depth.

4. **Emergency Tree Services & Storm Damage Cleanup** — 24/7 emergency response for fallen trees, hazardous limbs, and post-hurricane cleanup.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/emergency-tree-services
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/storm-damage-cleanup

5. **Land & Lot Clearing** — Heavy brush, invasive species removal, and acreage lot clearing.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/land-clearing

6. **Arborist Reports & Consulting** — ISA-certified arborist consultations, county permit applications, HOA compliance, and risk assessments.
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/arborist-reports
   - *URL*: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/consulting-arborist-services

7. **Other Tree Services**:
   - Tree Planting: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-planting
   - Wood Chipping: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/chipping
   - Hazardous Tree Removal: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/hazardous-tree-removal
   - Tree Canopy Thinning: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-canopy-thinning
   - Tree Crown Reduction: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-crown-reduction
   - Deadwood Removal: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/deadwood-removal
   - Brush Removal: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/brush-removal
   - Tree Mulching: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-mulching
   - Maintenance Contracts: https://tropicalsouthtreeservices.com/tree-maintenance-contracts
